laws.rule: Lucayan National Park: the Bahamas tourism authority prohibits swimming in its caves and requires a special permit for diving. BNT bylaw 11 also requires a warden or authorised personnel for cave entry or cave/sinkhole diving; it forbids smoking, fires, graffiti, releasing substances into cave water and touching cave artefacts.

items.text: Lucayan National Park caves: BNT bylaw 11 prohibits smoking tobacco or other products inside a cave. This is not a district-wide smoking rule.
